items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed fleet-wide; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; all security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced, but missing evidence is not a clean bill of health. Risk severity is high for public launch or security-sensitive release and medium for bounded changes that add no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: continue the existing security evidence work only; preserve private launch gates; do not deploy, requeue, change credentials or permissions, add dependencies, expand data collection, or conduct outreach. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, and data-handling boundaries.

Continue the existing fleet security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence or explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness. Do not create duplicate work or request telemetry already present.
